list.name: db_run
list.label: AvaCore run ID
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT run_id FROM rollouts_view ORDER BY run_id DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Saved results (latest 200; saving does not imply training selection)

targets.rawSql: SELECT query_id, trial_id, status, score, updated_at, left(reason::text, 500) AS reason FROM rollouts_view WHERE run_id = ${db_run:sqlstring}::bigint AND $__timeFilter(updated_at) ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 200

description: Provisioned only when AVATRAIN_GRAFANA_POSTGRES_URL is configured with a read-only, SELECT-only account. Database run IDs differ from dashboard run IDs. Uses existing rollouts_view; never loads full Trace JSON in the summary table.
